# @kurto/astro-seo-advanced

> Astro components for rendering SEO `<head>` markup from `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced` data. Handles meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, robots directives, canonical URLs, hreflang alternates, and JSON-LD structured data.

- Peer dependency: `astro` (>=5.17)
- Depends on: `@kurto/payload-seo-advanced` (^1.0.0)
- Install: `pnpm add @kurto/astro-seo-advanced`

## All-in-One `<SEO />` Component

```astro
---
import { SEO } from '@kurto/astro-seo-advanced'
const page = await getPage()
const seoSettings = await getSeoSettings()
---
<head>
  <SEO
    meta={page.meta}
    globalSettings={seoSettings}
    siteUrl="https://example.com"
    currentPath={Astro.url.pathname}
  />
</head>
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | `Meta` | Yes | The document's `meta` field from Payload |
| `globalSettings` | `Record<string, any>` | No | SEO Settings global data |
| `siteUrl` | `string` | Yes | Base site URL (e.g. `https://example.com`) |
| `currentPath` | `string` | Yes | Current page path (e.g. `/about`) |
| `doc` | `Record<string, any>` | No | Full Payload document (for JSON-LD) |
| `titleTemplate` | `string` | No | Title format override, e.g. `"%s — My Site"` |
| `titleDefault` | `string` | No | Fallback title when `meta.title` is empty |
| `ogType` | `string` | No | Open Graph type (default: `'website'`) |
| `locale` | `string` | No | `og:locale` value |
| `localeAlternates` | `string[]` | No | `og:locale:alternate` values |
| `languageAlternates` | `Array<{ href, hrefLang }>` | No | Hreflang alternates for i18n |
| `twitterCard` | `'summary' \| 'summary_large_image'` | No | Twitter card type |
| `twitterSite` | `string` | No | `@handle` for `twitter:site` |
| `twitterCreator` | `string` | No | `@handle` for `twitter:creator` |
| `robotsExtras` | `string` | No | Extra robots directives |
| `extend` | `{ meta?, link? }` | No | Escape hatch for arbitrary `<meta>` and `<link>` tags |

## Composable Sub-Components

Each can be used independently for granular control:

```astro
---
import { MetaTags, OpenGraph, TwitterCard, Robots, CanonicalUrl, LanguageAlternates, JsonLd, FaqJsonLd } from '@kurto/astro-seo-advanced'
---
```

- **`<MetaTags />`** — `title`, `description`, `keywords`
- **`<OpenGraph />`** — `title`, `description`, `url`, `ogType`, `siteName`, `locale`, `localeAlternates`, `image`, `articlePublishedTime`, `articleAuthor`
- **`<TwitterCard />`** — `title`, `description`, `image`, `card`, `site`, `creator`
- **`<Robots />`** — `robotsMeta`, `globalNoindex`, `extras`
- **`<CanonicalUrl />`** — `url`
- **`<LanguageAlternates />`** — `alternates: Array<{ href, hrefLang }>`
- **`<JsonLd />`** — `doc`, `globalSettings` (uses `generateSchema()` from payload-seo-advanced/utilities)
- **`<FaqJsonLd />`** — `items: Array<{ question, answer }>` (renders FAQPage schema, works in `<head>` or `<body>`)

## Title Construction Priority

1. `titleTemplate` — replaces `%s` with `meta.title`
2. globalSettings — `meta.title {separator} siteName` (skipped if `meta.disableSiteName`)
3. `meta.title` as-is
4. `titleDefault` fallback

## Image Handling

`meta.image` accepts a full media object `{ url, width?, height?, alt?, mimeType? }` or a plain URL string. Falls back to `globalSettings.defaults.ogImage` when no per-page image is set.

## Utility Exports

```ts
import { buildTitle, resolveImage, buildRobots, absoluteUrl } from '@kurto/astro-seo-advanced'
```
